environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in ECS Fargate behind ALB. Task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted at /tmp only. The SQLite database path /var/app/data/ is bind-mounted from an EFS volume configured with an IAM-authorized access point that grants read-only POSIX permissions (uid=1000, gid=1000, permissions=0555) on the data directory. The ECS task runs as a non-root user (uid=1000). Additionally, the task's IAM execution role has no elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite permission — only elasticfilesystem:ClientMount and elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess are denied via an SCP applied at the OU level. The EFS access point enforces root directory creation mode 0555 and the file system policy requires TLS and denies anonymous access.

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, security group restricts EFS port 2049 to task ENI only
